For the dungeon|Digsite Dungeon}} {{Infobox Location |name = Digsite |image = [[File:Digsite.png]] |release = [[9 July]] [[2003]] |update = New Digsite Quest! |members = Yes |location = [[Misthalin]] |teleport = [[Digsite pendant]] |map = {{Map|name=Digsite|x=3354|y=3420|height=300|width=300|zoom=2}} |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} {{Relative location |location = Digsite |north = Silvarea |west = Varrock |south = Exam Centre |east = River Salve }} The '''Digsite''' is an archaeological excavation area just east of [[Varrock]]. Players need to proceed far enough into the Dig Site quest in order to fully use it. This area is a members-only location. It is visited during several [[quest|quests]]. During [[The Dig Site]] quest, players learn that the area was once [[Senntisten]], the capital of the [[Zarosian Empire]] during the [[Second Age]]. During the quest, players find an [[ancient talisman]] and a [[Stone tablet (The Dig Site)|stone tablet]] telling all mortals to tremble before the power of [[Zaros]]. This area is said to be part of a city three times bigger than Varrock which supposedly reached to [[Edgeville]] (then known as [[Paddewwa]]). It was destroyed during the [[God Wars]] and replaced by [[Saranthium]], which was destroyed several hundred years before [[Avarrocka]] was established in 700 of the [[Fourth Age]]. For players who are doing or have completed [[The Dig Site]] quest, the north-west winch at the Digsite provides access to the [[Digsite Dungeon]]. A [[rope]] must be used with the winch to enter the dungeon. You will find 5 [[silver ore]] spawns and some level 22 [[skeleton]]s. ==Transportation== *[[Digsite pendant]] teleport to the Digsite *[[Senntisten Teleport]], then run north *[[Balloon transport system]] to [[Varrock]], then run east/south-east through one of the gatesThe worker's gate directly east of Varrock requires 153 [[Kudos]] to pass. *[[Ring of the elements]] to the [[Earth Altar]], then run east/south-east through one of the gates *[[Lumberyard teleport]] to the [[Lumberyard]], then run east/south-east through one of the gates *[[Gnome Glider]] to Lemanto Andra '''Notes''' {{reflist|group="d"}} ==Archaeology== {{Main|Soil|Panning tray|Specimen tray}} {{map|mapID=0|zoom=3|width=320|height=420|align=right |caption=Numbered map of the archaeological sites:
Training Digs: sites 8 and 9
Level 1 Digs: sites 6 and 7
Level 2 Digs: sites 2, 3, and 4
Level 3 Digs: sites 1 and 5 |mtype:rstext,label:1,fontsize:14pt,3373.7:3439.8 |mtype:rstext,label:2,fontsize:14pt,3356:3427 |mtype:rstext,label:3,fontsize:14pt,3369.5:3427 |mtype:rstext,label:4,fontsize:14pt,3352.5:3416.5 |mtype:rstext,label:5,fontsize:14pt,3353.5:3408 |mtype:rstext,label:6,fontsize:14pt,3361.5:3408 |mtype:rstext,label:7,fontsize:14pt,3369.5:3408 |mtype:rstext,label:8,fontsize:14pt,3354.5:3398 |mtype:rstext,label:9,fontsize:14pt,3369.5:3398.5 }} Players can dig at the Digsite during and after the quest. Although the exam in the [[The Dig Site]] quest suggests that the player must be wearing [[leather gloves]] and [[leather boots]] while having a [[rock pick]], [[trowel]], [[specimen jar]], and [[specimen brush]] in the player's inventory to dig, this is not actually the case. Different sites have different requirements as outlined below, and none actually require all 6 items. There are 9 different sites where the player can participate in Archaeology, spread across 4 different categories of dig: Training, level 1, level 2, and level 3. Each type of dig has its own requirements and table of possible finds. Players can also pan at the south-east part of Digsite with a [[panning tray]]. In the south-east section of the Digsite, it is also possible to search the [[specimen tray]] with a [[specimen jar]] in the inventory. For each type of archaeology, see the relevant main article linked at the top of this section for the possible rewards. ==Canal barge== {{Main|Canal barge}} [[File:Canal barge.png|thumb|The barge docked in the canal.]] The canal barge is a small ship built by the [[Varrock Museum]] just north of the digsite, east of [[Varrock]]. After the completion of the [[Bone Voyage]] [[quest]], the barge can be used to travel to [[Fossil Island]] by using the Quick-Travel option on the [[barge guard]]. The [[digsite pendant]] provides a [[teleport]] just next to the barge. ==Quests== *[[The Dig Site]] *[[The Golem]] *[[Desert Treasure I]] *[[Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire]] *[[A Soul's Bane]] {{The Dig Site}} {{Digsite}} [[Category:Misthalin]]
